jobs.prompt: Owner rule for the splitter and ticket path validation (tools/ticket-paths.mjs validateTicketPaths and its callers in tools/scope-commands.mjs: ticketPathCheckLines around line 415 and the edit path around line 3249; acceptance path ownership in tools/acceptance-provable.mjs and the tree check that prints 'acceptance line N names PATH, owned by nobody'). #310 stopped 'likely typo' on write paths but 'missing file' still parks about 30 tickets across projects on files the ticket itself creates. Rule: a path a ticket OWNS (anything in its files, its tests, and a contract it writes) may not exist yet and is never an error, whatever the ticket type. Only paths a ticket READS (context, contracts it only reads) must exist in the repo, or be created by a ticket it depends on, or by any other ticket in the ledger: in that last case do not park, auto-add the dependency (dependsOn that owner ticket, refusing an edge that would create a cycle, in which case drop the path from context with a warning and keep the ticket) and print a note 'T-A: added dependency on T-B (owns PATH)'. Acceptance lines that name another ticket's file: auto-add the dependency on the owner instead of parking; a glob in an acceptance line (for example tools/watch-assets/robot-*.js) is satisfied when any repo file matches it or any ticket owns a path matching it (add the dependency on that owner), and only when nothing matches at all is it a warning, never a parked ticket. Fixes needed: (1) fieldKind must treat the tests field as write for EVERY ticket type (today a test-type ticket's tests are read, so a new test file parks as missing file); (2) contracts: a path that appears in this ticket's own files is owned (a contract ticket writes contracts/api.json); a contracts entry owned by another ticket becomes an auto dependency; (3) context entries owned by other tickets become auto dependencies (today only the 'contextReachableOutputs' case is allowed); (4) unowned and nonexistent read paths remain an error with the closest real path suggestion. Add tests in tests/owned-paths.test.mjs using EXACTLY these cases: a test ticket that lists tests/unit/typed-part.test.ts (new file) in tests: no error; a ticket with tests e2e/checkout.spec.ts and e2e/cart.spec.ts: no error; a ticket with supabase/tests/rls.sql in tests: no error; a build ticket whose files are src/lib/new-module.ts and src/components/NewPart.tsx (new): no error; a contract ticket whose files include contracts/api.json: no error even when contracts also lists it; a build ticket whose contracts lists contracts/api.json that a contract ticket T-1 owns: no error and dependsOn gains T-1; an acceptance line 'UI mounts tools/watch-assets/robot-*.js for every agent' with an existing matching repo file: provable, not parked; the same with no match but an owning ticket: dependency added; a context path nobody owns and not in the repo: still an error with a suggestion; a cycle case: dependency would be circular: path dropped from context with a warning, not parked. Keep tests/ticket-paths*.test.mjs, tests/scope-ingest-paths.test.mjs, tests/scope-commands.test.mjs, tests/wave-prep-*.test.mjs, tests/split-*.test.mjs and tests/scope-integrity.test.mjs passing (update an old test only where it asserted that an owned path is a 'missing file' error).
